# Code of conduct

This project adopts the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
as its code of conduct, for everyone participating in its issues, pull
requests, discussions and other spaces.

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, focus on the work, and do not
harass, insult or publish others' private information.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainers through the
repository owner's GitHub profile, or through a
[private security advisory](https://github.com/DarkPhilosophy/Syntra/security/advisories/new)
if the matter is sensitive. Reports are handled confidentially.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues and
other contributions that do not follow this code, and may temporarily or
permanently ban participants, following the enforcement guidelines of the
Contributor Covenant.
